name: UCAC3 93-101439

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-815 and UCAC3 93-101439 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 5415648821879172096 and 5415648821874435584), 359 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.2e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-815, 359 AU away.

text.card: UCAC3 93-101439 is a star of 3,766 K, bound to TOI-815 359 AU away.
text.introduction: UCAC3 93-101439 shares its motion through space with TOI-815, 359 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: UCAC3 93-101439's orbit around TOI-815 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
